info.title: SC4 Prop Texture Catalog API
info.description: An API for the SimCity4 Prop & Texture Catalog. Github: https://github.com/noah-severyn/SC4PropTextureCatalog

get.summary: Search for TGIs via multiple fields
get.description: Primary search utility. Search across packages, files, TGIs, and exemplar names. Supports field-specific searches or a general search across all fields. Returns up to 2000 results.

parameters.name: term
parameters.description: General search term applied to all searchable fields (used when no specific field is provided)

parameters.name: package
parameters.description: sc4pac package identifier in the format group:name

400.description: Bad request - search term too long or too short, or invalid field specified

get.description: Search for resources by Instance ID (IID). Searches the last 8 characters of TGI identifiers to find matching instance IDs. Supports a single IID or a comma-separated list of IIDs.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: IID(s) to search for. Values with and without a preceding 0x are supported. Multiple IIDs can be provided as a comma-separated list.

400.description: Bad request - IID is blank, too long, or too short

get.description: Search for packages and retrieve aggregate statistics. If no search term is provided, all packages are returned with their statistics.

parameters.name: term
parameters.description: sc4pac package id in the group:name format. If omitted, all packages are returned.

400.description: Bad request - Search term too long or too short
